span.p:
THE RECURSION: every level is the same 8-ary butterfly.
Routing: destination address consumed 3 bits per level.
Scheduling: compile-time permutation rounds, system-wide, deterministic.
Verification: ONE chip theorem + ONE composition induction + ONE schedule checker
— cost grows with the STATEMENT, not the 64k instances.
